Message:
drm/i915: Handle -EDEADLK in drm_atomic_commit from load-detect.

CI runs with DEBUG_WW_MUTEX_SLOWPATH, so -EDEADLK occurs a lot more.
Handle the case where drm_atomic_commit fails with -EDEADLK correctly.
